title.en: The One With the New Secretary

description.es: Marta discute con Jesús sobre la nueva secretaria que se va a contratar en la fábrica y, aunque Jesús no quiere, Isabel acaba obteniendo el puesto.
description.en: Marta argues with Jesús about the new secretary to be hired at the factory, and although Jesús is against it, Isabel becomes the new secretary.
